name: abu
description: Agentic Brand Universe (ABU) skills: build and grow a typed, git-versioned brand universe by talking to your harness. START HERE: `abu` (hand it nothing and it reports where you stand, the highest-leverage next move, and a ten-minute one if you are bored) and `onboard` (installs everything and reports in plain language; never shows the user a command). generic tools for building and growing any brand/story universe (a typed, git-versioned, self-contained canon on the agenticstory engine). LIFECYCLE: start-new-story-universe (stand up a new universe with identity + register). AUTHORING (scaffold a typed entity + its reference-matrix slots): add-character, add-setting, add-visual-metaphor, add-motif, add-prop, add-story, add-relation. QUICK (no universe needed): create-style-pack (scaffold a portable Style Pack (SPEC 4.7) = pack.json + refs/ + a read-back gate, so a look becomes reusable and gated), create-lookbook (scaffold a Lookbook (SPEC 4.7.1) = the complement of a Style Pack: a curated but intentionally VARIED visual vocabulary - a wardrobe/fashion, a range of faces or building silhouettes - with a varietyRule + a variety gate, for what must stay on-aesthetic yet DIFFER per instance; motif/prop force sameness, a Style Pack is a medium; bound to a universe via a craft-canon register-rule that names it), on-brand-image (generate ONE image from a portable Style Pack (SPEC 4.7) - refs + palette + rejected poles + a read-back gate - for the common 'here is a folder of images, make more like them' case: deck plates, page heroes, icons; optionally takes a locked canon master so a recurring element stays identical). DECIDE (before you make the thing): explore - render a comparison SET that isolates ONE variable so a human decides a taste question by looking rather than by reading a description (what material, which register, how much shine, which form factor, which reading of a vague brief); fans N variants of one subject out in parallel through the provider adapter, holds everything except the axis identical via a --subject-file that is concatenated in front of every variant, stages every roll with its prompt beside it, and never deletes a candidate because a render has no seed and cannot be recovered; the verb the framework was missing, since every other art verb assumes the look is already decided. STRIP: compose-strip (two to four panels from a spec: each roll rendered through the entity route, judged by an agent who looked, rejects moved with their reasons and capped at the first roll plus four re-rolls, then composed in code with ONE composite recipe that passes a wiki provenance gate by construction; optional wiki WebP export and works-board staging). ART: shoot-references (SHOOT an entity's reference matrix: generate the art, read it back against the entity's invariants, then lock the passers with provenance; renamed from lock-references 2026-07-26 because that named the bookkeeping instead of the work), compose-spread (the atomic per-spread unit: canon-resolve + a deterministic prompt/refs assembler from canon that computes negatives from the selected looks so a per-book file can never contradict a character's canon alt-look, then generate + read-back), render-book (render a story into a picture book, reading identity + craft-canon; invokes compose-spread per spread), cover (the cover), update-book (edit an existing book; invokes compose-spread per touched spread), reroll-slot (re-roll ONE already-rendered slot as the .recipe.json beside it records - same prompt, same refs, and the recorded model unless it is superseded (then the adapter's current model) - with an optional --note delta, in ONE command and ONE image call, reading ZERO canon: resolves the recipe chain including derive sidecars, regenerates through the provider adapter so provenance is written by construction, replays the recorded conform/publish steps for endcaps, backs up the prior roll, ends with the render-readback reminder; the direct route for art-only edits like 'same but warmer light' or 'closing plate again, no lettering', and the WRONG verb for any edit that changes text/cast/look/setting/register, which re-resolves canon via update-book/compose-spread; earned by an 85-tool-call run that spent 71 calls re-reading canon that sat in the slot's own recipe). GATES (anti-drift forcing functions): canon-resolve (resolve refs before any render), render-readback (crop-zoom invariants after every render), casting-sweep (reuse-first before naming), voice-gate (voice-check before words/audio lock). Every canon skill takes a target universe and reads its universe.json identity + canon; none hardcodes a universe. on-brand-image is the exception by design: it takes a Style Pack path and needs no universe at all. make-a-work - THE GENERIC FRONT DOOR for any form a universe declares, so a new KIND of work is a FOLDER rather than a new skill: a form lives at <universe>/forms/<id>/ holding FORM.md (what it is, its goldens, how much evidence it rests on) and PROMPT.md (the method, which IS that form's composer) plus optional evals/, and forms.py discovers them, surfaces a form's STATUS warning up front, and REFUSES an unusable one rather than sending an agent to look for a method that does not exist. Reach for this whenever you are about to write a one-off skill for a new kind of artifact. create-form - author a NEW form (a new KIND of work) from works ACTUALLY MADE, never speculated (extracted from the two-universe precedent: fashion-look in christofuturism, living-diorama in gary-sheng-art): its scaffolder validates the id, REFUSES on zero evidence (the retired 896-line zero-works composer is the cautionary tale, kept by name), refuses to clobber an existing form, and stamps the evidence base into FORM.md's STATUS (ONE work is the legal minimum and stamps a hypothesis warning; at three or more it states the records-win rule instead); the method then distills FORM.md + PROMPT.md from the works' own records with gates and scripts named at the step that uses them, requires any eval to reproduce its goldens' recorded measurements before the form lands, and backfills a work.json declaration (form id + retrofit note) onto each evidence work while NEVER rewriting a historical README/recipe/attestation. Its chief precedent is the book chain itself (compose-spec, compose-spread, judge-slot, book-doctor, update-book): a form at full maturity in everything but declaration, standing outside forms/ for historical reasons only, and the trajectory every form grows along (newborn: FORM.md + PROMPT.md; growing: goldens-verified evals plus blind itemized fail-closed judging; mature: a composer, a doctor that grades the finished work, and update verbs). META (evolve the framework itself): pave-the-path - the RETROSPECTIVE sweep, wired in as the LAST STEP of make-a-book's chain (publish -> land -> pave) so it fires on every book rather than waiting to be remembered, and it INTEGRATES BY DEFAULT rather than filing suggestions: read the diff and the scratchpad (never memory), score the run's transcript with its review_run.py (tool histogram, first render touch vs first executed generation, and a one-line verdict like 'orientation-heavy: 71/85 calls before the first generation' - an orientation-heavy run usually means a missing DIRECT ROUTE, not a missing capability), find the hand-rolled code and repeated manual steps that WILL recur, and route the ones that pass its bar into deterministic substeps. Its bar is a naming sentence ('I hand-rolled X and the next invocation that needs X is Y'), it classifies each candidate PAVE/GATE/BUG/GUIDANCE/LEAVE, it records what it DECLINED, and it never edits the framework itself: it dispatches to evolve-abu, which keeps 'not yet' free. Distinct from fix-the-generator (the in-the-moment reflex) and from evolve-abu - invoke mid-session when you catch yourself hand-rolling framework-shaped work (a bespoke generate/provenance script, a missing scaffolder like create-style-pack, a look with no Style Pack); it promotes the hand-rolled thing UP into a skill/engine/spec, bumps the version, re-syncs + delivers the plugin, logs it, and updates itself. Nation of Fire is the reference implementation. Spec + engine live in THIS repo (agenticbranduniverse.com), which IS the marketplace (source '.'), so an install carries SPEC.md, the engine and the vendored providers with it rather than reaching into someone's home directory; there is no second repo and no sync step. AGENT (dispatch for any framework-shaped task): abu-steward - a framework-aware subagent whose whole job is to reach for the right verb instead of hand-rolling and to FLAG (never silently work around) gaps where the framework cannot yet do something sensible, escalating them to evolve-abu; reachable three ways so it is actually used rather than merely shipped: the /abu:steward command, a dispatch step in the abu front door, and make-a-book's chain. HEALTH: universe-doctor - grade how COMPLETE and high-quality a universe is on a fixed rubric (identity, entity reference matrices, setting size-contracts, provenance, craft-canon, stories, self-containment), returning a letter grade + per-dimension scores + a prioritized punch-list naming the framework verb that closes each gap; the rubric is the framework's definition of a done, good universe (complements validate + lint-universe). KIT: add-piece-or-no-go (record a brand PIECE - a reusable part with its exact recipe or a pointer to the canon that defines it - or a NO-GO - what is refused, why, the piece to use instead - with who decided it, when and in what words, into a SPEC 13.1 kit record; validate holds every quote and supersession to live canon, and `abu check-kit` scans a surface's source and refuses a detectable no-go). WORDS: add-or-update-line (record ONE golden line - one approved unit of the brand's language - into the universe's lines record (SPEC 13.2), or bless, reword or retire one, always with who said yes, when and in what words; every earlier wording is kept, and a yes from anyone but a listed approver is refused). (universe-doctor also defines DOCTOR MODE: an autonomous loop that keeps grading and improving a universe with the right verbs, texting the operator each gain, until told to stop.) book-doctor - grade a RENDERED book on local disk against what its render-spec declares, before it is delivered anywhere: every declared spread exists, the ENDCAPS (front cover and closing plate) are portrait while interiors are landscape, every asset carries its provenance recipe, no spread was generated from another spread render, and optionally every cast entity is registered and locked; delivery-agnostic by design (no bucket, no CDN, no network), so it complements rather than replaces a delivery platform's own probe, and its provenance + self-reference checks are ones a delivery probe structurally cannot do because recipes never ship. LANDING: land-work (merge a finished work branch home in ANY git repo instead of leaving it parked; classifies the target branch as free/idle/busy so it never moves a branch out from under a live sibling worktree, and QUEUES a blocked merge so the next run drains it; also prunes worktrees whose branch is already merged). make-a-playable-deck - build a mobile-friendly PLAYABLE slide deck from slides declared as DATA: one self-contained HTML file with fit-to-viewport scaling so nothing scrolls on a phone, horizontal-intent swipe, deep-linked slides, a draggable scrub bar across the whole argument, and the palette read from the universe's own tokens rather than typed; nine slide kinds including `pair` (a rejected candidate beside the pick) and `chat` (a recreated exchange), with unknown keys REFUSED BY NAME because a mistyped key is the one defect a deck cannot show you. Extracted from one deck already used in front of a real audience, so the kinds are a hypothesis. Reach for it whenever the ask is to send someone an argument to sit with rather than a document to read.
